name: Slack - CEO
tagline: Reads your Slack channels each weekday, flags problems and posts approved wins
description: Runs a weekday pass across every channel in the workspace, reading it from leadership's vantage point to pull out problems needing a decision and wins worth naming. Congratulation posts reach the company-wide channel only once a human has approved the wording, and vendor signatures stay out of whatever it writes.
author: lamps109
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
